newsitem.title: USA: USDA to buy 20 Mln lbs turkey to bolster prices.
newsitem.headline: USDA to buy 20 Mln lbs turkey to bolster prices.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday it would buy 20 million lbs of turkey meat, including all-white meat roasts and deli-style breasts, to bolter meat prices.
In addition, purchases of regular turkey roast for use in the school lunch program will be moved up.

The initiatives were expected to alleviate pressure on turkey producers and to bring supplies more in line with demand, USDA said. Large cold storage stocks have contributed to depressed turkey prices, it said.
